scripts.dev: uv run --locked python manage.py migrate --noinput && uv run --locked python manage.py runserver --insecure ${PORT:-3000}
scripts.start: uv run --locked --no-dev python manage.py migrate --noinput && uv run --locked --no-dev python manage.py runserver --insecure --noreload ${PORT:-3000}
scripts.lint: biome check . && uv run --locked ruff check . && uv run --locked ruff format --check .
scripts.ci: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test
